name: 24.QF3

origin.summary: Test 3 of the 2024 CrossFit Quarterfinals. The Quarterfinals sit between the worldwide Open and the Semifinals in the CrossFit Games season — a harder online stage for the top slice of Open finishers.

description: A chipper built almost entirely around handstand push-up variations, escalating from regular to strict to wall-facing, each paired with a different gymnastics movement.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/quarterfinalsindividual/2024/3 (official CrossFit Games Individual Quarterfinals workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
